text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp has begun. Taking 
careful care of her body, Duramente 
gradually steps up her preparations for 
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Not the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, but the 
Kikuka Sho— She shared her intended race 
entry with Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, Kitasan Black seemed to fire 
herself up once more. It looked like this 
was going to be one hot summer training 
camp.
